name: CookHoard
purpose: Local cooking assistant for recipes, fridge-aware recommendations, a weekly menu and a unified shopping list. It imports recipes from video links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook) and pasted text into reviewable drafts, keeps a pantry with places and expiry dates, reads supermarket tickets into prices, costs recipes and menus against a weekly budget and warns every morning about food that is about to expire. Everything stays on the computer.

x-links.hub: local chat and vision models through Hoard Link chat()

notes: Run npm install and npm run build once in CookHoard, then start the app (npm start, or let Faustus launch it): the MCP bridge proxies every call to the running app, starts it when it is not answering and falls back to running the tools in-process (COOKHOARD_MODE=inprocess forces that, COOKHOARD_AUTOSTART=0 disables the auto-start). Both share one kitchen.json under COOKHOARD_DATA_DIR (default %LOCALAPPDATA%/CookHoard) guarded by a cross-process lock; a version 1 kitchen migrates on the first write and the original is kept as kitchen.json.v1.bak. Video links need yt-dlp (settings: media.ytdlp or COOKHOARD_YTDLP; Instagram and TikTok often need cookies from Edge, Chrome or Firefox, or a cookies.txt file) and optionally ffmpeg for key frames; without them text, pages with structured data and tickets still work. Every recipe read from a video or text is a draft with the line that justified each ingredient; nothing is saved until it is accepted. Quantities that a model suggests are only kept when the source text contains the number. Missing models, Funes, Kafka, Ledger or Tantalus are reported as such, never faked. The daily routine at 09:00 (with catch-up after the computer was off) emits cookhoard.pantry.expiring; COOKHOARD_SCHEDULER=0 turns it off. Only local requests are accepted (COOKHOARD_ALLOWED_HOSTS adds host names). Mutating tools: pantry_set, shopping_mark_bought, ingredient_add, ingredient_alias_add, price_add, recipe_draft_accept/discard, import_recipe_*, ticket_import_*, ticket_line_map, settings_set, import_kitchen and the original kitchen editors; deletes only when the user asks.
